data.name: Gym Beginner Full Body
data.description: Three identical full-body sessions a week with a rest day between them. A good first program if you are new to the gym.

data.name: 3 Day Split
data.description: Three sessions a week, each for a different part of the body: chest, shoulders and triceps; back and biceps; legs and core.

data.name: Cycling — Beginner (Week 1)
data.description: A seven-day beginner cycling week built around heart-rate zones.

data.name: Gym Machines Beginner
data.description: Three sessions a week on machines only, alternating two sessions. A gentle way into the gym before you move on to free weights.

data.name: Gym Upper / Lower
data.description: Four sessions a week: two for the upper body and two for the lower, one heavy and one lighter of each. For people with a few months of training behind them.

data.name: Gym Push / Pull / Legs
data.description: Three sessions a week, split by movement: pushing, pulling and legs. Each muscle is trained once a week.

data.name: Gym Push / Pull / Legs 6 Day
data.description: Six sessions a week with one rest day: pushing, pulling and legs, each done twice with different exercises. For experienced lifters who recover well.

data.name: Gym Strength 5x5
data.description: Three short barbell sessions a week built on five sets of five. Session A is done on Monday and Friday, session B on Wednesday.

data.name: Bodyweight Beginner
data.description: Three sessions a week at home with no equipment at all. A good start if you have not trained before.

data.name: Bodyweight Intermediate
data.description: Four sessions a week: two for the upper body, one for the lower body and one for conditioning. You need a pull-up bar.

data.name: Dumbbell Full Body
data.description: Three whole-body sessions a week with one pair of dumbbells, alternating two sessions.

data.name: Dumbbell Upper / Lower
data.description: Four sessions a week with one pair of dumbbells: upper body and lower body, each done twice.

data.name: Resistance Band Full Body
data.description: Three whole-body sessions a week with a resistance band. Easy on the joints and easy to take with you when you travel.

data.name: Kettlebell Basics
data.description: Three sessions a week with a single kettlebell, alternating the slow lifts with the fast ones.
